prerequisites: First and second degree equations and inequalities
Notions of counting, factorial, and binomial coefficients
Notions of numerical sequences, arithmetic and geometric sequences
Logarithm function (complementary mathematics or mathematics specialty in 'terminale' grade)

learning_outcomes.text: Reason and demonstrate, write a proof.
Compare orders of magnitude and apply them to asymptotic calculations.
Use analytical tools to solve an equation.
Manipulate the main mathematical tools useful in physics.
Implementation of methods and tools within the disciplinary field.
Identification of a questioning within a disciplinary field.
Analysis of a questioning by mobilizing disciplinary concepts.

syllabus_topics: Real numbers: inequalities, absolute value, bounds.
Numerical sequences: sums and products, linear recurrent sequences, monotonic sequences, bounds, notion of convergence, operations on limits, equivalent sequences, Landau notations.
Functions of a real variable: generalities, bijections, extrema, common functions.

Limits and continuity: definitions of limits and continuity, operations, notion of equivalents and Landau notations, comparative growths, asymptotes, properties of continuous functions, inverse functions of circular and hyperbolic functions.
Differentiation: definition, operations, derivatives of common functions, properties of differentiable functions, application to the study of variations.
assessment_rules: Evaluation is based on continuous assessment, weighted at 100%.
